blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Then set off on a 4-hour tour to Corcovado with an English-speaking guide.

An open, eco-friendly train runs from the station to the summit through the jungle. On either side of the track is Tijuca Forest, home to monkeys, birds and other wildlife.

At 700 m above sea level stands the 38 m statue of Christ the Redeemer, built in 1931. From the viewing platform, you can see the Niterói Bridge, Guanabara Bay, the Botanical Garden, Maracanã Stadium, Sugar Loaf Mountain and other parts of Rio.

**Optional excursion: Helicopter flight over Rio de Janeiro**

A helicopter flight over Rio can be booked at an additional cost; price on request.
